AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: These functions allow chefs to discover and learn how to cook simple recipes. Operational Patterns: - Use 'searchRecipes' to search for recipes using various filters. - Use 'getRecipeDetails' to get the details of a specific recipe by ID. - Use 'getRecipeDefinition' to look up the definition of a cooking-related term. Constraints: - At least one filter must be provided when searching for recipes. - If provided, the recipe query cannot be blank. - If provided, the minimum and maximum calories must be between 0 and 2000. - If provided, the recipe rating must be between 1 and 5. - The recipe ID must be positive. - Recipe terms cannot be blank.
